explanation: Shrunk scenario has two massive bodies (0:13.46 and 1:6.13) on converging trajectories. Separation falls from 1.27 at step15 to 0.548 at step17 to 0.138 at step18, dropping below softening length 0.3. Potential deepens -327 to -791 and kinetic rises 513 to 925 over same interval, but substeps_in_step stays capped at 6 for dt=0.0281. Leapfrog with insufficient adaptive substeps cannot resolve rapidly varying softened force at sub-softening distances, causing large systematic energy drop (-56 between 17 and 18, total drift 50.89 > allowed 34.39) while momentum/angular momentum stay conserved. Reducing dt to 0.01 restores energy conservation.
vision_note: Panels 15-17 show two blue bodies in the upper-left converging until they are nearly touching at step 17. At step 18 they abruptly overlap into a single larger blob, indicating an extremely close encounter/collision while the other bodies remain stationary.
